title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page box: wide boxes (at least 1.8:1) run the trail left to right with the dash share beside it; other boxes put the dash share over a trail that rises from the catcher. vertical: the playfield runs left to right and older movement rises away from the catcher. horizontal: newest movement at the right, the playfield's left edge at the top.

title: Alignment
description: Side the readouts lean to. left (default) keeps the dash share clear of the screen edge, where osu!stable's input overlay sits beside the right-hand column; right puts it on the outer edge.

title: Trail length (seconds)
description: How much gameplay time the trail shows, newest at the catcher. Clamped to 2–30 s.

title: Dash share
description: Share of gameplay time spent dashing this attempt, breaks excluded (the same number as catcher-heatmap). Off leaves the trail alone.

title: Hold on results
description: Keep the attempt's dash share and direction changes on the results screen, along the bottom of the box; osu! does not show movement stats there.

title: Motion
description: full = a miss rings out once where the catcher was, results readouts rise in, the overlay fades in and out. reduced = no miss ring; fades and the results rise stay. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.
